messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 16):
"""
Any Individual or Group Health Insurance Product offered with a term exceeding one year, shall be continued on the agreed terms for all the existing policyholders for the entire policy term. Provided in case of Group Health Insurance Product, the PMC shall put in place guidelines for withdrawal. The guidelines, inter alia, shall address the basis of the withdrawal, the notice period to be made available to the Master Policyholder, options to be offered if any, to the Master Policyholder and/or the insured members of the Group. 7. All the distribution channels shall be informed about the withdrawal of a product well in advance. 8. Any premiums or deposit received towards the product that is withdrawn, but where no policy has been issued, shall be refunded to the policyholders immediately.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"If a group health insurance product is withdrawn, what must the PMC do regarding withdrawal guidelines?","answer":"The PMC must put in place guidelines for withdrawal, addressing the basis of withdrawal, the notice period to the Master Policyholder, and any options to be offered to the Master Policyholder and/or insured members.","facts":["the PMC shall put in place guidelines for withdrawal","The guidelines, inter alia, shall address the basis of the withdrawal","the notice period to be made available to the Master Policyholder","options to be offered if any, to the Master Policyholder and/or the insured members of the Group"]},{"question":"What happens to premiums received for a product that is withdrawn before any policy is issued?","answer":"Any premiums or deposit received towards the product that is withdrawn, but where no policy has been issued, shall be refunded to the policyholders immediately.","facts":["Any premiums or deposit received towards the product that is withdrawn, but where no policy has been issued, shall be refunded to the policyholders immediately"]}]}
